# AdaptiveNetworkResilience

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The emergent property of a network to maintain functional performance under dynamic perturbations by continuously adjusting its topology based on node-level health states. Directly applicable to TCC/iNEST for designing self-healing interconnects and neuromorphic substrates that adapt to component degradation or environmental stress.
